transcript.text: If I had to raise prices on customers
tomorrow, this is the letter that I
would send them. So, my price raise
letters have five sections and I use the
acronym raise to remember it. So, R
stands for remind them of the value
they've gotten. A is address the price
change directly. So, don't try and like
hide it somewhere, like be up front. I
is invest in their future. Basically,
frame the price increase in the context
of the value that you're going to keep
investing in to help them out. S is
soften the news with a loyalty discount
that expires in 3 to 6 months from now.
And then E explain away their concerns
with a PS statement at the bottom of the
letter. And so, this is what it looks
like when it's all together. If this
sounds interesting, follow for more free
stuff.
